What this is

Paver installation in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services offers commercial and residential paver installations to transform the current look of your property. Our professional installers can install driveways, walkways, patios, and more. Adding pavers will add to the aesthetics of your property.

Pavers are also the one hard surface that can be taken up and put back. A poured slab that cracks is a demolition job; a paver field that settles is an afternoon. That matters more in Central Florida than most places, because our sand moves.

Questions

Before you call.

Can pavers go over an existing concrete driveway?

Sometimes — it depends on the condition of the slab and on the height you have to work with at the garage door and the kerb. It is one of the first things we check on site, because the answer changes the job completely.

Do you do commercial paver work?

Yes. Blue Fox offers commercial and residential paver installations.

How long does a paver driveway take?

It depends on square footage, access and what has to come out first. The estimate visit is where you get a real answer rather than a guess.

Tell us about the property and we will come back to you. Estimates are free — the only thing that carries a fee is digital design work, and that is credited back if the package is approved.
